source.extractionPreview:
UNIT 2
Motor 
Fitness
In this unit, we will learn about the importance of 
fitness. We will also understand that being fit can 
help us to be healthy and strong. Here are a few 
things we can do to be fit:
1. 
Endurance: We will do fun activities that will 
help us to play longer without getting tired.
2. 
Building strength: We will get stronger with 
regular exercise. It will build our muscles and 
bones.
3. 
Becoming flexible: When we stretch and 
move in guided ways, our bodies will become
